title: Hide repeated deep collaboration chains
why: Deep navigation couples a class to an entire collaborator graph.
suggestion: Consider a higher-level query or narrow facade.
limitations: Requires three chains of at least four hops across two methods; AST visitor implementations and analyzer or rule-pack orchestration classes are excluded.

The shared analyzer excludes Java class literals, direct qualified-type declarations, and completed builder/newBuilder/toBuilder chains. Arbitrary fluent APIs and unresolved static symbols are not inferred.

Java zero-argument factories explicitly declared to return a nongeneric Builder-suffixed type also qualify as construction when the chain completes at build(). Lookup uses unambiguous project type names with simple static receivers or explicitly typed parameters; field/local aliases, generic return types and ambiguous type names are not resolved.
Comments, strings, generated, test, example, and vendored sources follow normal analysis classification and suppression controls.
